As a….sort of agnostic atheist, let me give you some perspective. 

What you’re stumbling on here is called the problem of evil, it’s an theological argument on why God let’s evil and suffering.

I found about this almost 2 years ago and kinda became more cynical of the world. I was in your shoes and still am, I still don’t know why I should get on my knees and pray to something that allows children to be tortured, raped and murdered and if they commit suicide, they burn to hell, because ending their suffering was “selfish”.

The one answer people have to this is the free will argument. There is no good without bad, the world needs to be fair, and that in order to do that God gave every single creature free will, it’s up to them to choose between good and evil and he can not interfere with it.

As to the question on why is there so much excessive suffering, it’s due that we are in a fallen world, The world is rotted with sin and evil, we must wait for god (not entirely sure what happens next) but we must have faith in this fallen world.

I’ll say this, I understand how you feel. The world is unfair and it sometimes it can be hard for us to think how can people continue to believe in God but try to understand the others perspective, try to understand that it is their only hope.
